title: Nu, pogodi!
tagline: Ну, погоди! Catch every egg before it hits the ground.
description: A fan-made rebuild of the Elektronika IM-02 LCD handheld of 1984, in Rust on game-toolkit, native and in the browser.

cover.alt: The handheld's LCD: the wolf with his basket between four chicken coops, eggs rolling down the ramps toward him.
